text: **Ra.One** is a 2011 Indian science fiction film directed by Anubhav Sinha and starring Shah Rukh Khan in a dual role as a video game programmer, Shekhar Subramaniam, and his superhero creation, G.One. The film follows the story of a video game developed by Shekhar, which features two main characters: G.One, a good-natured protagonist, and Ra.One, a powerful antagonist with self-learning AI. The game is designed to allow players to experience digital worlds, and when activated, the characters come to life in the real world. The plot centers on the conflict between G.One and Ra.One, with G.One attempting to protect the protagonist, Prateek, from Ra.One's destructive actions. The film features extensive use of visual effects and action sequences, and explores themes of technology, artificial intelligence, and human emotions. It was a commercial success, becoming one of the highest-grossing Indian films of all time, and received mixed to positive critical reviews. The film also includes a special appearance by Rajinikanth, who reprises his role as Chitti from the film *Enthiran* .
